messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — High error rate on dedicated inference pool eu-west-2 (pool-id: ded-eu-42). Observed 5xx spike at 14:02 UTC, error ratio ~18% over 2m. Paging oncall. https://internal.ops/alerts/1802501234

alex (oncall): on it. beginning triage. switching oncall to ops-pager for bandwidth. pinging SRE lead.

ops-pager: ack. moving to incident channel and creating bridge. bridge: https://meet.internal/bridge/1802501234

maria (sre-lead): jumping in. alex — can you dump /tail logs and check model variant fallback? suspect routing fallback misconfig after last deploy.

alex (oncall): running quick checks. kernel errors? no. 503s mostly from model shard 3 on g4dn-8xlarge. pushing KILL then restart on those nodes.

maya (eng): saw increased queue latency + OOMs on shard 3 yesterday during smaller burst test. I have a hotfix ready to disable aggressive batching for that shard. can deploy if needed.

jordan (csm): quick heads up — customers on Dedicated EU list: Novara Health (NVR-001), Lexi Finance (LXF-22), Orion Payments (ORN-9). Novara has active HL SLA and 24/7 contacts. Sam, you had the direct phone?

sam (acct-mgr): yes — Novara primary: pri-ops@novara.com, +44 7700 900111 (ops lead: Priya Shah). Escalation to engineering after 15m. I can call once we have confirmed impact.

maria (sre-lead): update: restarted shard processes, error ratio down to 6% but still elevated. rolling config change to disable packing on shard 3 now (taking 30s).

alex (oncall): applying change...

incident-bot: CONFIG ROLLOUT started for ded-eu-42: disable_batching=true (rollout id r-1802501234-1). Monitor window 5m.

maria (sre-lead): monitoring — tail shows steady fall to 1.8% errors. latency back to normal for most customers.

jordan (csm): crafting status message for Novara now. Proposed short customer note below. please approve and advise routing.

jordan (csm): ```
Hi Priya,

We’re investigating an elevated error rate affecting inference requests served from our EU dedicated pool starting at ~14:02 UTC. Our on-call team has applied a targeted configuration change to mitigate the issue; error rates are now returning to normal.

Impact: transient increased 5xx errors and latency for a subset of requests routed to your dedicated pool. No data loss or model integrity issues reported.

Current status: mitigated — normal service restored for most traffic. We will follow up with post-incident notes and any action items.

If you’re seeing ongoing failures please reply here or call +44 7700 900111 (Priya). Apologies for the interruption — Jordan, Customer Success
```

maria (sre-lead): message looks good. add the MAP ID and timeframe: 14:02–14:18 UTC. Also note we did a config rollback to disable packing on shard 3.

jordan (csm): updated: ```
Hi Priya,

We’re investigating an elevated error rate affecting inference requests served from your EU dedicated pool (ded-eu-42, MAP NVR-001) starting at ~14:02 UTC. Our on-call team applied a targeted configuration change (disabled request packing on shard 3) which mitigated the spike; error rates returned to baseline by 14:18 UTC.

Impact: transient increased 5xx errors and higher latency for a subset of requests. No data loss or model integrity issues reported.

Current status: mitigated — normal service restored for most traffic. We will follow up with a summary and next steps including durable config changes and stress-test plan.

If you’re seeing ongoing failures please reply here or call +44 7700 900111.

Apologies for the disruption — Jordan, Customer Success
```

sam (acct-mgr): approved. I’ll place a call to Priya to confirm they see the same. I’ll CC eng if they want to join.

alex (oncall): monitoring looks stable. incident-bot, mark as partial mitigation.

incident-bot: Incident 1802501234 — status updated to PARTIALLY_MITIGATED by alex (oncall) at 14:20 UTC.

maria (sre-lead): next steps: schedule postmortem, add runbook item to avoid packing on that instance type for now, and run a focused soak test at 20:00 UTC with similar traffic profile. tagging eng for follow-up.

maya (eng): will owners create a PR for the durable disable and add test harness? I can pick it up after 15:00 UTC.

jordan (csm): Sam — once call with Priya done, please confirm here so I can send the customer note.

sam (acct-mgr): call done — Priya confirmed partial failures from 14:05–14:16, she’s happy with note and wants an exec-safe summary after postmortem.

alex (oncall): closing pager. leaving follow-ups to SRE and CS. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PAGER CLOSED for 1802501234 — origin ded-eu-42. Final state: mitigated. Postmortem assigned to maria (sre-lead).

maria (sre-lead): filing postmortem and internal comms template now. I'll include customer impact table and routing matrix for enterprise customers (Novara, Lexi, Orion).

jordan (csm): internal comms template (short) below — use for execs and cross-functional: ```
Internal: Service degradation in EU dedicated pool (ded-eu-42) impacting Novara Health (NVR-001), Lexi Finance (LXF-22), Orion Payments (ORN-9).
Timeline: 14:02 UTC - 14:18 UTC
Root cause: aggressive request packing led to resource contention on shard 3.
Mitigation: disabled packing on shard 3; error rates returned to baseline.
Customer impact: transient 5xx errors for subset of requests; no data loss.
Action items: durable config change, soak test tonight, postmortem and customer follow-up.
Owners: maria (SRE), jordan (CS), sam (AM)
```

maria (sre-lead): good. tagging infra to schedule urgent soak. assigning postmortem to me; will include remediation timeline.

alex (oncall): thanks everyone.
